strings.en: If you don't wanna get hurt, back off!
I'm short on patience... All-out attack!
Your luck ran out when I spotted you!
I'll show you the difference in skill!
I'll teach you how harsh reality is!
You've got guts showing up in front of me!
Flailing around now won't save you!
Hold still. I'm shooting you down!
That one's mine to shoot down!
Pretty cheeky of you to defy me!
This here's a Gesh Kai built for me!
I'll show you what Type G can do!
With this Gesh Kai, I can go all out!
Get ready for a beatdown from the Boxer!
If this thing were red, it'd be perfect!
I'll crunch you up with this Cerberlion!
This is our turf! If you wanna do/　business, go do it somewhere else!
Don't get cocky, you Golaikunru merc!
I'll show you what happens when you tick me off!
So-Des, keep mocking me and/　you're gonna regret it!
The Fury's got some lively ones too!
Get cocky and you'll get hurt, Jua-Mu!
I ain't got time to mess with you!/　I'm going all out, Jua-Mu!
Picking a fight head-on, huh? I like that!
If you're the Fury's ace,/　then I'll take you on!
Black Raftclans, don't you move an inch!
I'll beat you down and drag your boss out!
Trying to take Earth with cheap tricks?/　That ain't what an emperor does!
You're gonna pay for this in full,/　Gu-Landon!
I'll make you regret picking a fight with us,/　Gomoudokka!
Clear the way to the Rabulpaila!
If you're the royal guard, you're worth fighting!
Reggiane, you're the one who's gonna bleed!
If you like red that much,/　I'll show you some blood right now!
The bigger they are, the more fired up I get!
Only your face gets to be a joke, clown boy!
Now that's a belly worth punching!
I'm sick of your magic tricks, Debudedabide!
Whatever's controlling you, I'll smash you!
If it's unmanned, I just gotta wreck it!
I don't care what's possessing you!
Monsters get along with monsters, huh?!
I'll smash you to pieces, Crystal Dragoon!
First I cut off the tail! Then the wings!
I'll rip those wings right off!
Heh, let the monster hunt begin!
Skeleton freak, I'll crack you open!
If there's no meat, I'll just break bone!
Whatever's inside you, I'm taking you down!
You're the one who's going down! You junk battleship!
No matter how many times you come at us!
I'll kick Golaikunru/　right out of the Earth Sphere!
Go home before you get hurt real bad!
I'll cut loose so hard/　you can't ignore me!
I'll crush the Zovorg commander unit!
Looks like it's got backbone,/　but what about the pilot?!
I'll blow a big hole in that ship's belly!
Here's one with some real good moves!
For now, I'll just smash it/　and check its performance!
I ain't got time for Fury small fry!
Hauling something heavy on your back, huh!
I'll smash those big shoulders to bits!
That horn sticks out too much!
Take out the head! That's the rule!
Take down the leader, and the rest are just a rabble!
Whoever stands out gets targeted first!
That spiky jerk's the commander unit?!
Details can wait till after I smash it!
If you're trying to get in our way,/　you're gonna pay!
If you're coming, I'll take you on,/　Gadisword!
That weapon's my style! Hand it over!
I'll take the big one with the scythe!
Ghost or whatever, I'm smashing it anyway!
Monster! I'm gonna hunt you down!
Gotta finish off the Lamaris fast!
Since they combined,/　they're easier to wipe out in one go!
Tch, that's just barely/　on the safe side of gross...!
Kaana or Ida, I'm smashing it all the same!
Interesting! If you want a rematch, you got it!
Tch, I gotta stare it down to hit it... Ugh, whatever!
No good, that one's the worst... Damn it!
Damn, it reminds me of that Space Flounder!
Monsters like that don't bother me!
The overall look's fine, but that face, though...
The Einst didn't bug me, but this one's iffy...
I'll make you regret/　comin' at me!
You picked a fight, so.../　you know what's coming, right?
Screw you.../　Don't think you're getting off easy!
Every fight you sell, I'm buying!
Payback's double or more,/　that's the going rate!
You touched me? That'll cost ya!
This ain't gonna be settled that quick!
They got the first hit, so I gotta pay 'em back good!
You bastard, you'd better remember this!!
Screw you!/　Don't you run after doing all this!
Ngh! I'm getting worn down here!
Damn! What the hell's going on!?
You bastard...!/　Don't think you're leavin' in one piece!
Remember this,/　you're gonna see a whole lot of blood!
Ugh...! Fine then,/　I'll go all the way!
This thing's so heavy...!/　Move right, Alt!
Toughness is your selling point, right?! So hold up!
Gespenst! Don't you go down yet!
Don't you dare turn into a ghost/　and take me with you!
Pathetic! Are you all bulk, Jigan!?
You're a Gespenst too! Show some guts!!
Y-You'll pay for this!/　I'll throw you into the Cross Gate later!
No point if I get taken down first!
Like hell I'll lose to an oversized Lamaris!!
That Lamaris got bigger,/　so now it's going nuts!
Dammit, that thing's gonna show up/　in my nightmares!
Wh-why is a fish on land...!?
Hah!/　You think you can take me on with that!?
Ngh, like I can run!/　Not with Russel watching!!
Ow! Don't get cocky/　just 'cause you landed one!
That's half-hearted!/　Put some real Spirit into it!
Why, you... You'll pay for this!/　I'll get you back, count on it!!
You're holding back!/　Like that's gonna sink me!!
...!? More damage than I thought?/　This ain't fun...
I'll teach you that half-hearted/　attacks come back to bite you!
Thick armor's its selling point!/　That ain't getting through!
That's the Alto for ya./　...Or not. It's taking a beating!
I'm not letting this thing/　get any redder!
It's thin, but it'll hold out, right?
Wha?! This thing... Make the armor tougher!
Damn it!/　Let's show some Spirit, Gespenst!
Took a good hit./　But Jigan can still go!
You needed one more push/　to take down Jigan!
If you wanna take down this Gespenst,/　you need more push!
Tch, taking a hit from Jua-Mu!
I'm about done/　playing with you...!
It can move like that with that bulk?!
Damn it! I'll beat you so bad/　you'll lose all interest in Earth!
Reggiane, I'll pay you back for this real soon!
Getting cocky 'cause you never run outta breath!
Damn it! Tasuku's enough of a magician for me!
Like hell I'll become lizard food!
I can't end this with aliens mocking me!
Getting got by Fury small fry...!
Ugh! That Raftclans is no joke!
Monster! I'll scatter you in no time!
Ugh! Like hell I'll let the Lamaris beat me to a pulp!
Throwing these weird attacks at me...!
Damn it, monster! That one hurt!
Ugh! It didn't just change on the outside!
Russel! Put a mosaic over that thing's face!
Ugh! Gotta beat it fast,/　or it's bad in a whole other way!
Heh! You think/　that's enough to take me down?
Hm? Did you just do something?
That all you got? No other tricks!?
Damn it!/　Getting hit like that? Pathetic!
Tch, a necessary expense!/　I'll pay it!
A scratch like this, I'll just have Tasuku polish it out.
It's tougher than it looks,/　this Gespenst!
You'll need more Vigor than that/　to break Jigan's Guard.
Don't get cocky just 'cause you landed one, Jua-Mu!
No need to go easy on me, Al-Van!
I'll give you credit for speed, Fu-Ruu!
That's all the Emperor Unit's got?!
Reggiane, want me to teach you/　how to dish out punishment?
On Earth, we say old folks shouldn't overdo it!
Light attack, Skull Knight. 'Cause you're all bones?
Tch, getting latched onto by Zovorg small fry...
Like hell I'll lose to a spiky jerk!
Monster, that's a fun attack you've got there...
Whoa, so the only thing with impact is your looks?
Shallow. Weren't you supposed to be powered up?
Ngh! Gotta watch close or I can't dodge!
Gotta look good in front of Russel!
Don't lump me in with some amateur!
Hmph, what's got you so rattled?
This thing turns on a dime!
The Boxer's got way better reflexes!
I know how to handle a Gespenst!
Is your glare the only sharp thing about you,/　Karo-Ran?!
I can't stand your type, but a fight's another story!
You picked the wrong gal to play with fire,/　Gomoudokka!
Showing up in front of me in that color?/　You've got guts!
What a waste of a good thing, Herluga!
A puppet thinks it can hit me?/　A million years too early!
Where are you looking, junk battleship?!
I've got Yon's data,/　so your attacks are an open book!
Swarm me, and I'll take you all out at once!
Heh, how are you even the boss like that?
Like hell a monster's gonna exterminate me!
Like a Lamaris is gonna beat me!
No matter how the Lamaris change,/　it means nothing if they can't hit!
Heavyweight or not, it means nothing if it doesn't hit!
Damn it, stay away from me!
I'm not taking any pointless damage.
I can't stop yawning at this rate.
That all you got? Then I'm done with you!
I've got extra Boosters on this thing!
Hmph, I expected some kind of Superior.../　But you're nothing special.
With that attack, and you still miss?/　Pathetic!
Whoa there, you sure have momentum, if nothing else.
Is the magic show over, clown boy?!
Go on, make some excuses, lizard!
Well, that's a monster's attack, alright,/　but it's useless if it doesn't hit.
All show and no substance, huh?
I'd slice you into sashimi... Nah, no way.
You won't get a free hit on me!
Go home and don't come back!
Tch! What the hell is this!?
Remember this. I don't let things go easy.
Outta my way! I'm going in!
Like I'd pass up a chance this sweet!
Russel!/　Go at 'em harder, damn it!
Out of the way! I'm taking it from here!
Kyosuke! I'll wrap this one up!
Excellen!/　Put some more Spirit into it!
Bullet! You didn't finish the job!
Radha! Leave the rest to me!
Couldn't finish it off, Tasuku!?/　You're getting punished later!
Fine... I'll cover for you, Tasuku!
Leona! Leave that one to me!
Leona, I'll give you a hand!
Lüne, leave the rest to me!
Arado! Keep it up, keep pushing!
Gotta show 'em how a senior does it!
Nice, Michiru!/　Keep it up next time too!
Akemi, leave that one to me!
Hiryu Custom! I'll back you up!
Leave the rest to me, SRX Team!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
C'mon, c'mon! Out of my way!
Tasuku! My punishment hurts way more!
Arado!/　You're in for it later, same as Tasuku!
Tryin' to take it head-on?/　I like your vigor!
I'll beat the crap outta all of you at once!
I'll smash you in one go!!
I ain't the type to let an opening slip!
I'll drive it in even deeper!!
I'll push right through in one go!
Well then, time for some fireworks!
I love this thing's finishing move!
Don't think this is some toy BB gun!
Claymore! You won't get off easy!
This'll leave you a tattered rag!!
There ya go, go punch that guy!
Outta the way, outta the way!
Time for the Bilgar's flight show!
B or E, who cares! Eat this!
Take that, and that, and that!!
I'll show you how harsh reality is!
B, E, what a pain!/　I'll fire 'em all at once!!
You'll get way worse than a bloody nose!
Let me hear a good scream!
I'll slam the Gandoro's power into you!
Slam and done! Jigan, max output!
Don't think you can stop this!
Take the express to the afterlife!!
No matter where you hide, it's useless!
The edge on this is somethin' else, huh?
Heh... So if I'm holding this,/　that makes me the Alt?
Hah, this weapon's right up my alley!
Smash! Just keep smashing till you drop!!
Have a taste of.../　my Boost Hammer!!
Heh, I love weapons like this!!
This thing cuts on a whole other level!
I'll show you what happens.../　when you put a blade in my hands!!
To hell with later! Let it all rip!
First, a shower of steel balls!
Next, the horn sends you flying!
I'll nail you to the gates of hell!!
Here we go! On to the next!
I'm not out of ammo yet!
This is way easier to handle!
This mode's plenty for the likes of you!
Short range is/　more my style!
Honestly, I'd rather/　just punch your lights out!
Take my iron fist,/　and go straight to heaven!
This thing stretches into a long weapon!
Here we go, punch right through!!
Heaven or hell, take your pick!!
Which way will your tomorrow go!!
I had a hand in/　designing this motion!
Stepping into my ring/　was your bad luck!
Listen up,/　after the Magnum comes the Phantom!
This is what Type G's all about!
Take that, and that, and thaaat!!
Just sit still and take it!!
You're a fish on the chopping block!
Heh, this thing's packing some sweet gear!
This iron fist hurts just as much!
Behold a super fighter's true power!
All right, time for the worst luck/　of your life.
This is one big gun emplacement! Go!!
Shoulda ridden the one with the drill!
This is what I'm talkin' about!/　Drill Attacker!!
Rapid hits are fine,/　but let's end it in one shot!
Here it comes, right down the middle!
I'm not holding back!/　The brass can foot the bill!!
Heh, now that's one deluxe Missile!
On moonless nights,/　watch the sky above you!
I don't need telekinesis to do this!
Have a good taste of my fist!
This is my ace, get ready!
Once I've caught it, it's mine!
I'll load you up with all kinds of stuff!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
I haven't had enough rampaging yet either!
Don't be shy, take it alllll!!
Raising some hell? That was a full-on rampage.
I'll slam it home with style!!
I'll show you how to use a bayonet!
I'll break that nose of yours!
In the end, it's gotta be!
Lighting my fire was your bad luck!
I'll send you to the afterlife!!
And hit you with the real thing!
I'll hit you with everything the Varga's got!
